name: Mathilde Payne

events.title: First marriage
events.description: Married William B. Cucey Jr. (DC marriage record)

bioAdditions: FamilySearch: daughter of Richard Payne and Maria Colton; first married William B. Cucey Jr. in Washington, D.C., on 21 Nov 1911, then Leo G. Heffernan at Chicago on 24 Dec 1915; later Mrs. McLaughlin; died 14 Nov 1972, buried Mount Olivet, Washington (S1).
